title: Kummer etale G-covers and their quotients after fs base change
statement:
Let $C,D,E$ be locally Noetherian fs log schemes [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], let $G$ be a finite group of order invertible on $D$, and let $q:C\to D$ be a Kummer etale $G$-cover. Here Kummer etale means log etale [def-per-fs-log-smooth-etale] with injective characteristic monoid maps for which every element of the target has a positive multiple in the image. A $G$-cover means that $G$ acts over $D$, $q$ is finite surjective, and the canonical map $\coprod_{g\in G}C\to C\times_D^{\rm fs}C$, given on the $g$th copy by $(1,g)$, is an isomorphism. The superscript fs denotes the fibre product in the category of fs log schemes. For any morphism $E\to D$ for which $C_E=C\times_D^{\rm fs}E$ is locally Noetherian, $C_E\to E$ is again a Kummer etale $G$-cover. Its underlying scheme has quotient $E$: the map is finite surjective with orbit geometric fibres and
$$\mathcal O_E\simeq(q_{E*}\mathcal O_{C_E})^G.$$
The quotient log structure is $M_E\simeq(q_{E*}M_{C_E})^G$. The constructions and identifications commute with composition of fs base changes. No flatness of $E\to D$ and no triviality of its log structure is assumed. In particular, the very tame finite quotient of [lem-per-very-tame-log-quotient], when the action is free on the log-triviality locus, is a Kummer etale $G$-cover in this sense, so these conclusions apply to its fs base changes.
